title: Updating Beta parameters with counts
description: You can connect observed successes and failures to a next-trial prediction.

steps.description: beta_posterior adds k successes to alpha and n minus k failures to beta. You return both updated parameters.
posterior_predictive returns alpha divided by the parameter sum. The driver starts from 2 and 2 with 12 successes in 20 trials.

steps.question: Which parameter pair does the update return?
steps.answer: It returns 14 and 10, adding 12 successes and 8 failures to the prior parameters.

steps.description: You see posterior Beta parameters 14 and 10. Both the posterior mean and next-trial predictive mean print 0.5833333333333334.
